messages:
alexa: Quick sync — thinking about how we prioritize auth/tenant controls for the next API surface milestone. TL;DR: need a concrete launch checklist that balances self-serve and enterprise asks.

jordan: +1. Can we break down by risk/cost/effort? My rough take: org-scoped keys (low effort), project-scoped scoped keys (med), key rotation UX + tooling (high), fine-grained tool-calling scopes (high), audit log retention + export (med).

mira: From a security/compliance view: rotation + auditable keystore + KMS integration are blockers for Enterprise SLA. Org vs project scoping affects blast radius — org-scoped keys need strict RBAC and org admin controls.

sam: Sales feedback: customers repeatedly ask for project-level keys so they can hand dev teams delegated creds without touching org billing. Also they want rotation to be non-disruptive (rolling replace + policy).

alexa: Good context. Proposing prioritization for next quarter: 1) project-scoped API keys (self-serve+enterprise) 2) key rotation tooling (CLI + Console + API) 3) clear fallback behavior for expired keys (403 vs 401 + retry hints) 4) audit/export hooks 5) scoped tokens for tool-calling. Thoughts?

jordan: Implementation notes: project-scoped keys require model to resource mapping changes and minor routing updates. Rotation automation needs key-lease metadata and endpoint to fetch current & previous keys — we can support rolling rotation via a short TTL and 'verify-only' endpoint. Perf impact should be negligible.

mira: Also require HSM/KMS support for private deployments. For hosted customers, KMS integration should be opt-in but recommended. Need threat-model doc before GA.

ellie: From CS: migration path is key. If we ship org->project split, we need a self-serve migration tool + clear warnings in Console. Customers will want a preview mode.

alexa: Agree. Launch criteria proposal: (a) project keys + Console UX, (b) rotation API + CLI + docs, (c) audit events emitted to our events pipeline, (d) migration preview + rollback plan, (e) security signoff + threat model. If any of (a)-(c) missing, mark GA as "enterprise beta".

sam: Pricing ops note — project keys may affect billing attribution. Need to map project->billing and confirm edge cases (cross-project usage). Will sync with finance.

jordan: For the rotation API: sketch: POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate -> returns {"old_key_id", "new_key_id", "status"}. Provide header `X-Active-Key` to opt into a specific key during rollout. Also recommend server-side caching of key metadata with short TTL (30s) to avoid DB hits.

alexa: Nice. Add UX: Console shows "Rotate" flow with dry-run and validate endpoints step. Also add policy doc: automatic rotation cadence (90d default) + org override.

mira: Can we add an optional policy to enforce rotating third-party tool/event hooks? Eg require rotated webhooks to update — otherwise send an alert.

ellie: Customer success will want webhooks on rotation events. We should include a subscription event `key.rotated` with payload: project, user, timestamp, rotation_id.

alexa: Putting these into roadmap draft. Action items: jordan -> tech design + estimate (end of week). mira -> threat model + compliance checklist. sam -> collect top 5 customer asks and billing implications. ellie -> migration UX notes + copy. I'll assemble launch criteria doc and share.

deploy-bot: Reminder: RFC draft created: https://rfd.redwood.dev/r/327-auth-tenancy (created by alexa)

alexa: Thanks all. If no objections I'll slot this into Q2 roadmap and mark enterprise GA gated on rotation + audit. :thumbsup:
